verses.text: Then Job answered:
"If only my pain could be weighed, and all my troubles put on a scale!
They would be heavier than all the sand of the seas. That is why my words have been wild.
The arrows of the Almighty are stuck in me, and my spirit drinks their poison. God's terrors are lined up against me.
Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass? Does an ox moan when it has food?
Can you eat food that has no taste without salt? Is there any flavor in the white of an egg?
I refuse to touch such things. They make me sick.
If only I could have what I ask for! If only God would give me what I long for,
that God would be willing to crush me, that he would reach out his hand and cut off my life!
Then I would still have this comfort, and I would jump for joy even in unending pain: I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
What strength do I have, that I should keep hoping? What future do I have, that I should be patient?
Am I as strong as stone? Is my body made of bronze?
I have no power to help myself, and any chance of success has been taken from me.
A person who is about to give up should get kindness from his friends, even if he stops respecting the Almighty.
But my brothers have been as untrustworthy as a stream, as streams that run dry.
In winter they are dark with ice and hidden under snow.
But in the dry season they disappear. When it is hot, they vanish from their beds.
Travelers turn aside from their paths to find them. They go out into the desert and die.
The travelers from Tema look for water. The traders from Sheba hope to find it.
They are disappointed because they trusted. They get there and are confused.
Now you are just like those streams. You see something terrible and become afraid.
Have I ever said, 'Give me something,' or 'Pay something for me from your wealth'?
Have I said, 'Rescue me from my enemy,' or 'Save me from cruel people'?
Teach me, and I will be quiet. Show me what I have done wrong.
Honest words are powerful! But what does your arguing prove?
Do you want to correct what I say, and treat the words of a hopeless man as wind?
You would even throw lots for orphans and sell your friend.
Now please look at me. I would not lie to your face.
Please stop. Do not be unfair. Think again, because my innocence is at stake.
Is there anything evil on my lips? Can't I taste what is wrong?
